My research sits at the intersection of competition economics, econometrics, and applied data science, largely developed alongside my work at CADE (Brazil's antitrust authority) and as adjunct professor at UNIPAMPA.

## Selected articles

- Stanford Computational Antitrust (2026) — on Structured Analytics for Bid-rigging Monitoring (SABM) and large language models applied to cartel detection.
- Revista do Serviço Público (2026).
- Revista de Defesa da Concorrência (2022).
- Revista do IBRAC (2021, 2022).

## Working papers

- CADE Working Paper 2/2023 (*Documento de Trabalho CADE 2/2023*).

## Books & book chapters

- *Mulheres no Antitruste*, vol. 5 and vol. 6 — contributing chapters.

## Data projects

Independent, open-source data projects, published on GitHub:

- [beatlenomics](https://github.com/taniseb/beatlenomics) — economics and causal inference applied to The Beatles and Paul McCartney's live career. See the [#beatlenomics](beatlenomics/index.qmd) section on this site.
- [mapasicms](https://github.com/taniseb/mapasicms)
- [megasena](https://github.com/taniseb/megasena)

For the complete and up-to-date list of publications, see my [Lattes CV](http://lattes.cnpq.br/8929030311500731) or [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=YTuig-gAAAAJ) profile.
